answer: An agent market for timber, voyage planning, and sable pelts can allocate paid jobs by a lottery weighted by escrowed stake, with funds locked for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities gives an attacker the same total chance of winning as staking 100 tokens under one name. To capture more jobs, the attacker must lock up more capital for the full period; creating extra identities alone buys no advantage.
